name: Performance Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for performance work: a short set of checks to run before calling a performance task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for performance work: a short set of checks to run before calling a performance task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. Measure before optimizing any performance bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.
2. State assumptions about performance explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.
3. Validate performance outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.
4. Keep performance changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
5. Check that performance terminology is used consistently throughout, matching existing conventions in the surrounding context.
6. Prefer explicit, readable performance solutions over clever ones that are hard to verify.
7. When multiple performance strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
8. Document any non-obvious performance decision with a short rationale so future readers understand the 'why', not just the 'what'.
9. When performance decisions are ambiguous, favor the option that is easiest to reverse or extend later.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Avoid mixing unrelated performance concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.
- Do not skip documenting performance assumptions just because they seem obvious in the moment.
- Do not treat a single passing example as full verification of performance correctness.
- Do not silently drop performance edge cases to make an example look cleaner than the real system.
- Avoid introducing new performance abstractions before there is a second concrete use case that needs them.

CLOSING NOTE
When in doubt, prefer clarity and explicit reasoning about performance over a shortcut that saves a few lines but hides intent.
